judgment: On the road, holding firm: good.
image: So the noble one is clear and careful in punishments,
lines: this is where disaster is got.
his money held to his chest,
he gets a young servant. Holding firm.
he has his money and his axe.
Shooting a pheasant: one arrow lost.
In the end, praise, and a posting.
A cow lost, in ease. Misfortune.

notes.name_en: 旅 is the sojourner away from home; 'Travelling' (the state, not Wilhelm's person 'The Wanderer').
notes.L5: 譽命 praise and an official charge/appointment — 'a posting'.
notes.L6: 喪牛于易: 易 as ease again (cf. 34 L5), loss through carelessness at rest.
